purpose: Audit the scoring-semantic change required to remove the hidden punkt_tab dependency from TextRank and LexRank.

implementation.old_reference: sumy.nlp.tokenizers.Tokenizer('english').to_words, which calls nltk.word_tokenize with preserve_line=False and therefore requires downloaded Punkt data
implementation.new_path: nltk.word_tokenize(canonical_sentence, preserve_line=True) followed by sumy's inherited Tokenizer._is_word filter

hash_contract: For each sentence, JSON-encode the filtered token tuple with ensure_ascii=false and compact separators, append LF, and update SHA-256 in canonical row/sentence order.

first_mismatch.text: Dressed in an orange jail uniform and walking with a cane, a hand-cuffed Patrick Sullivan, 68, watched as a judge raised his bail amount to a half-million dollars and sent him back to the Patrick J. Sullivan Jr. Detention Facility.

decision: Use preserve_line=True because the governed input is already one frozen canonical sentence and CI/offline execution must not depend on downloaded Punkt data. This is an intentional word-scoring change, not parity. Keep all pre-hotfix TextRank/LexRank metrics historical and rerun both baselines before formal citation.
